# Psi (Ψ) — AI-readable design system

See `packages/tokens/llms.txt` and `packages/react/llms.txt` for per-package machine-readable artifacts and authoring rules.

- packages/mcp/llms.txt — MCP tools (search, get, theme, check), hosted at https://psi.kurkin.de/mcp, init command for AGENTS.md
- https://psi.kurkin.de/docs/llms.txt — every docs page (guides, components, tokens) as markdown

**Specs and plans** (principles, architecture, decisions): `docs/superpowers/specs/` and `docs/superpowers/plans/`, one file per change, named `<date>-<topic>`. Decisions are numbered from D1 upward in each spec's `## Decisions` section; the newest specs carry the highest numbers. The founding spec is `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-12-design-system-design.md` (D1–D26).
